name: types
description: Shared TypeScript utility types, common Zod schemas, and a Database type slot.
docs:
Shared, dependency-light TypeScript building blocks.

- Utility types: `Brand` (nominal types), `Prettify`, `Maybe`, `Nullable`, `Awaitable`, `ValueOf`, `DeepPartial`, `RequireKeys`, `OptionalKeys`.
- Common Zod schemas: `emailSchema`, `uuidSchema`, `slugSchema` (kebab-case), `idSchema`, `paginationSchema` (coerced `page`/`pageSize` with bounds).
- A recursive `Json` type and a `Database` type slot — replace `Database` with your generated DB types (Supabase `gen types`, ORM-inferred, etc.).

Requires `zod` for the schemas; drop `src/schemas.ts` and its re-export if you only want the types.
